;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019–20 Lebanese protests]]
**Clashes between protestors and security forces at a protest camp in [[Beirut]] leave dozens of people injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/dozens-injured-police-clash-protesters-lebanon-191215054752981.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**Twenty-two civilians are killed by Islamist militants in [[machete]] attacks in the town of [[Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-security/militants-kill-22-in-eastern-congo-despite-claims-of-security-progress-idUSKBN1YJ0KC?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.dw.com/en/islamist-rebels-kill-dozens-in-dr-congo/a-51684794 (DW News)]
*[[Citizenship (Amendment) Bill protests in India]]
**Violent protests against the [[Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019|new citizenship bill]] break out in [[Delhi]], leaving at least six dead. The protestors, numbering in the thousands and containing numerous students, were dispersed by [[Delhi Police|police]]  using [[tear gas]] and [[baton charge]]s. The police also stormed the campus of [[Jamia Millia Islamia|Jamia Millia Islamia University]] to arrest protestors fleeing the scene while clashing against students. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/india-killed-assam-protests-citizenship-law-191215070715487.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Censorship in China]]
**State broadcaster [[China Central Television]] pulls a [[Premier League]] match between [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] and [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] from its schedule after Arsenal [[midfielder]] [[Mesut Özil]] criticized China's [[Xinjiang re-education camps|re-education camps in Xinjang]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2019/dec/15/mesut-ozil-china-uighur-muslims-arsenal-manchester-city (''The Guardian'')]   

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Davao del Sur earthquake]]
**At least seven people are confirmed dead while 37 more are injured after a [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude]] 6.9 earthquake strikes [[Matanao, Davao del Sur|Matanao]], [[Davao del Sur]], in the [[Philippines]]. [https://sputniknews.com/asia/201912161077585528-at-least-7-people-killed-as-result-of-earthquake-in-southern-philippines-reports/ (Sputnik)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/earthquake-philippines-1.5397035 (AP via CBC News)]
*At least ten people are killed by a fire at a [[Fan (machine)|fan]] factory in [[Gazipur]], [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-factory-fire/fire-at-bangladesh-factory-kills-10-people-idUSKBN1YJ0IA?il=0 (Reuters)]
*A bus carrying 32 [[Hinduism|Hindu]] pilgrims veers off a highway in central [[Nepal]], killing at least 14 people. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/14-killed-in-nepal-pilgrimage-bus-crash-12185588 (Channel News Asia)]

;International relations
*[[Libya–Turkey relations]], [[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)]]
**[[Turkey]] says it is ready to provide [[Turkish Armed Forces|military]] support to the [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]-based [[Government of National Accord]] (GNA) against [[Khalifa Haftar]]'s forces if requested to do so by the GNA. The [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey]] approves military intervention in [[Libya]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-libya-security-erdogan/turkey-ready-to-give-any-military-support-libya-needs-erdogan-idUSKBN1YJ0LB (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/turkish-lawmakers-sign-libya-military-support-deal-191215114132175.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**[[Hong Kong Police Force]] clash with protesters at different malls across [[Hong Kong]] amid a visit by [[Chief Executive of Hong Kong|Chief Executive]] [[Carrie Lam]] to [[Beijing]]. Riot police use [[pepper spray]] to disperse crowds as a result. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-mall-protests-flare-with-leader-lam-in-beijing-idUSKBN1YJ09S (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
**In a non-binding referendum organized by the Chilean Association of Municipalities, 91% of the voters support a new Constitution and more than 70% of the voters support a fully elected [[constituent assembly]] to write it. An [[2020 Chilean constitutional referendum|official referendum]] will be realized in April 2020. [https://www.latercera.com/nacional/noticia/consulta-ciudadana-resultados-preliminares-revelan-846-110-personas-estan-favor-una-nueva-constitucion/940360/ (''La Tercera'')]
